# Visual Studio Code GUI Interface Description

## Window Header and System Information

- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "Visual Studio Code" on the left side.
- **System Date and Time**: "Oct 23 01:29" is shown in the center of the title bar.
- **System Tray Icons**: Located on the right side of the title bar, including:
  - Network/Connection icon
  - Sound/volume control icon
  - Power button icon
- **Window Control Buttons**: Three buttons on the far right of the title bar:
  - Minimize button (dash icon)
  - Maximize/Restore button (square icon)
  - Close button (X icon)

## Application Menu Bar

- **Menu Items**: A horizontal menu bar with the following items from left to right:
  - File
  - Edit
  - Selection
  - View
  - Go
  - Run
  - Terminal
  - Help

## File Menu Dropdown

- **File Menu is Open**: The "File" menu is expanded, showing a vertical list of options.
- **Menu Items**:
  - New Text File (Ctrl+N)
  - New File... (Alt+Ctrl+N)
  - New Window (Ctrl+Shift+N)
  - Open File... (Ctrl+O)
  - Open Folder... [Ctrl+K Ctrl+O]
  - Open Workspace from File...
  - Open Recent (with right-pointing arrow)
  - Add Folder to Workspace...
  - Save Workspace As...
  - Duplicate Workspace
  - Save (Ctrl+S)
  - Save As... (Ctrl+Shift+S)
  - Save All
  - Share (with right-pointing arrow)
  - Auto Save
  - Preferences (with right-pointing arrow)
  - Revert File
  - Close Editor
  - Close Folder [Ctrl+K F]
  - Close Window (Alt+F4)
  - Exit (Ctrl+Q)

## Left Sidebar (Activity Bar)

- **Application Icons**: A vertical column of application icons on the far left side of the window.
- **Icons from Top to Bottom**:
  - Google Chrome icon
  - Thunderbird email client icon
  - Visual Studio Code icon (blue "VS" logo)
  - VLC media player icon
  - LibreOffice Writer icon
  - LibreOffice Calc icon
  - LibreOffice Impress icon
  - GIMP image editor icon
  - File manager icon (folder)
  - Ubuntu Software icon (orange "A")
  - Help icon (blue circle with question mark)
  - Trash icon (recycle bin)

## Main Content Area

- **Welcome Page Title**: "Visual Studio Code" in large font, followed by "Editing evolved" in smaller font.
- **Start Section**:
  - Title: "Start"
  - Options:
    - New File... (with document icon)
    - Open File... (with folder icon)
    - Open Folder... (with folder icon)
    - Connect to... (with arrow icon)
- **Recent Section**:
  - Title: "Recent"
  - Message: "You have no recent folders, open a folder to start."
- **Walkthroughs Section**:
  - Title: "Walkthroughs"
  - Options:
    - Get Started with VS Code (with star icon) — Description: "Customize your editor, learn the basics, and start coding" — This option is highlighted with a blue underline.
    - Learn the Fundamentals (with lightbulb icon)

## Status Bar

- **Bottom Left Corner**:
  - Status bar with icons and indicators:
    - Source control icon (branch with plus sign)
    - Zero indicators for errors, warnings, and other statuses
    - A gear icon with a notification badge showing "1"
- **Bottom Right Corner**:
  - Checkbox labeled "Show welcome page on startup" — Checked
  - A small icon resembling a person or user profile

## Window Controls

- **Window Maximize/Restore Button**: Located in the top-right corner of the window, represented by a square icon.
- **Window Minimize Button**: Located to the left of the maximize/restore button, represented by a dash icon.
- **Window Close Button**: Located to the right of the maximize/restore button, represented by an X icon.

## Visual Styling

- **Color Scheme**: Dark theme with black background and light gray or white text.
- **Font**: Clean, sans-serif font for all text elements.
- **Icons**: Simple, flat design icons for all buttons and menu items.
- **Spacing**: Ample spacing between menu items and sections for readability.
- **Highlighting**: Selected menu items and active walkthroughs are highlighted with a blue underline or border.
